_what: Every falsifiable claim the exit-status contract makes at b0d4cce, each with a mutation that makes it FALSE. A claim is PINNED when that mutation turns at least one node red. This is the denominator behind the '>80% measurable' target.
_measured: b0d4cce (764 nodes): behaviour 16/16, prose 2/5, overall 18/21. P01, P03 and P04 each came back with a FULLY GREEN suite.
ff58237 (767 nodes): behaviour 16/16, prose 5/5, overall 21/21. The three killers are the three nodes added in that commit.
Calibration is run on 3981efd, where the two answers are known by hand: CAL-RED red, CAL-GREEN green. It still reads that way after the fix, which is what licenses believing the 21/21.
